definitions.unit: the radius; every count is out of the usable seeds at that radius
definitions.first_split: the first logged step at which a uid present at the start has a daughter, minus the first logged step
definitions.one_disc: `--init-spots R:0` places one disc; the flag's two centres coincide

controls.reuse: radii 4.5 and 6 must reproduce the split times recorded in X140 and X138, seed by seed
controls.start: one component of area >= 20 cells at the first logged step

verdict: the lone radius-3 disc splits at a median of 180 steps, in line with radii 4.5 and 6, and a pair at gaps 1-8 is one body by step 50: the split time is not what sets the boundary at radius 3
